svg.title: AI Automation for Customer Support
svg.desc: Animated branching decision-tree workflow showing how Enablly's forward-deployed AI automation handles customer support: customer messages arrive via email, chat, and WhatsApp; an AI triage agent sorts intent and urgency at a decision diamond into three branches — Branch A (common questions answered automatically via RAG with OpenAI and Claude), Branch B (billing or account issues prepared via tool calling with HubSpot and Zendesk), and Branch C (urgent or angry customers fast-tracked straight to a human without automation). Branches B and C merge at a human-in-the-loop check, and three outcome cards show every message handled.
